properties.title: Fandry UI: composable UI components for Salesforce LWC
properties.description: The flexibility of modern UI development with the simplicity of LWC. A themeable, composable component library for Salesforce LWC, LWR and Experience Cloud.

properties.title: Why Fandry UI exists | Fandry UI
properties.description: What Fandry UI is for, what it trades away, and how it differs from Lightning Base Components: your own design system, composition, and components you control.

properties.title: Getting started | Fandry UI
properties.description: One source, one npm package, two platforms. Pick the one you build on; the components are the same.

properties.title: Getting started with LWR / LWC OSS | Fandry UI
properties.description: Install one npm package, point your project at it, and use <fandry-*> components. Your bundler ships only the ones you use.

properties.title: Getting started on Salesforce | Fandry UI
properties.description: The platform has no bundler and cannot import npm packages, so the CLI copies components into your project as source you own, with everything they depend on.

properties.title: Theming | Fandry UI
properties.description: Set --fd-* tokens to theme colors, type, spacing, radius and motion for a site, a section or one component, and ::part() to restyle one element.

properties.title: Components | Fandry UI
properties.description: Every Fandry UI component for Salesforce LWC, with a live example, its props, parts and the code to use it.
